What audio can I link?
Anything with a URL: MP3 files, podcast episodes, SoundCloud tracks, voice notes on Drive. If a browser can play it, the code can open it.
Does the code contain the audio itself?
No — it holds the link. Keep the file online at the same address and the code plays it forever.
Can I link Spotify or Apple Music?
Yes — paste the share link. Note listeners may need that app installed; a direct MP3 link plays everywhere.
Will it play automatically on scan?
Phones open the link in the browser or audio app; autoplay depends on the listener's settings. Most tap play once.
